title: 14 第十四章
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

非自然事件就像蟑螂，等人意识到它们存在的时候，已经泛滥到哪哪都是了。

[鉴定术]迅速给了都竞华回应，新软件中确实存在游戏中的力量，主要作用是定位，一旦发现佩戴者状况不对，会自动开始摄像并将信息传输回去。如果是直接与神经元连通的那种新式通讯器，监控力度还要更强。

都竞华轻轻呼出一口气，手指轻轻触摸了一下自己的手腕。

她的通讯设备款式非常古早，不抗摔，怕火也怕水，过热会自动关机。所以都竞华专门为其安装了一个防护壳，拍摄前必须手动调整防护壳位置将摄像头露出来。而且因为款式老旧，无线充电功能不好使，所以时不时就得拿下来一段时间。

都竞华从未想过，有朝一日自己居然能从贫穷中获得安全感。

遗迹那边的工作取消后，假期中的学生们陡然变得无所事事起来。都竞华后续应该尽快退租并返回学校，不过办退租手续跟收拾行李也需要时间，要是房东难缠，可能还得额外耽误些时日。加上快毕业了，校方并不会强求学生住在宿舍中，她就算拖到开学再往回跑也不显得奇怪。

太阳高悬在天空上，却几乎要被林立的高楼完全遮蔽，即使此刻还未入夜，街道上已经闪烁起了令人炫目的霓虹。

形状奇异装饰独特的交通工具在空中飞驰而过。

在红浮市，普通人的飞车只能在固定区域行动，不过只要支付足够的金钱就可以申请专用车道，曾有法律人士认为这样会侵犯高层住户的空间隐私权。自由大学的法学院就曾为此展开过辩论。

坐上回程的空轨，都竞华将自己找了个空位坐定，开始思考今天突然返校的缘由。

副本、游戏……种种事件都昭示着，这个世界正在发生着翻天覆地的变化，自己非法玩家的身份或许已经引起了某些人的注意，对方可能是察觉到了什么，但不清楚目标是谁，也有可能是古代遗迹学的学生本身就存在引人注意的特质，所以才派人前来查探情况。

暂时不去管背后之人的想法，都竞华离开校园后就直接赶回了西区的租房，简单收拾了下并吃了一碗便捷营养餐，就开始为周常任务做准备。

她没打算一直不登录游戏主城，但在登录之前，足够的武器储备是必要的。

都竞华的背包里有之前从《村庄庆典》内带出来的木头，她将下载了危险软件的通讯器放到客厅充电，自己蹲进卧室里手搓箭矢。

之前用无名宝石升级[大众脸]的时候，都竞华领悟了一个锻造类技能[物品合成]，她想试试看能不能把狼牙镶嵌在箭矢上。

都竞华将狼牙打磨后，嵌入箭矢的头部，然后使用技能，双方十分顺利地融合在了一起。

镶嵌狼牙的箭矢比普通箭矢的攻击力高上10点，还有概率造成流血效果。

将所有带出来的狼牙消耗完毕后，都竞华的物品合成技能就升到了中级，她心中清楚，今天制作箭矢获得的经验其实相当有限，她能这么快升级，更多是因为之前用了无名宝石，使用高阶材料制造物品能带来更多的经验。

都竞华整理了下旧箭囊，将箭矢分类放好——她很喜欢旧箭囊，相比起来，背包虽然也能储存箭矢，但不同类型的箭矢必须放在不同的背包格中，而且最高叠加数只有99，箭囊则可以同时容纳不同类型的箭矢。

可惜手头上的矿物不多，在都竞华的印象里，用金属制作箭头，还一定概率赋予为目标穿透效果，具体概率与防御值成反比。

浮现在脑海中的记忆就像意外跌坏的雕塑，有些地方前后连贯，有些则成了溅落四处的粉末，细碎又无序。

获得了《村庄庆典》的所有权就可以定期获得副本收获。所有收获会随时间不断累计，目前已经获得了两单位的兔肉，还有一单位的森林鼠尾草，不知道后续还会不会有其它类型的材料。

森林鼠尾草在村庄郊区能够找到，比一般的鼠尾草效果更好，能够制作出品质优秀的治疗药剂。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Unnatural events are like cockroaches. By the time people realize they exist, they have spread everywhere.

[Identification Technique] quickly responded to Du Jinghua. The new software does have in-game power. Its main function is positioning. Once it finds that the wearer's condition is not right, it will automatically start taking pictures and transmit the information back.If it is a new type of communicator that directly connects to neurons, the monitoring intensity will be even stronger.

Du Jinghua breathed out softly and touched his wrist lightly with his fingers.

Her communication equipment is of a very old style. It is not resistant to falling, is afraid of fire and water, and will automatically shut down if it overheats.Therefore, Dujinghua specially installed a protective shell for it. Before shooting, the position of the protective shell must be manually adjusted to expose the camera.And because the model is old, the wireless charging function doesn’t work well, so I have to take it off for a while from time to time.

Du Jinghua never thought that one day he would be able to gain a sense of security from poverty.

After the work at the ruins was cancelled, the students during the vacation suddenly became idle.Du Jinghua should quit the rent and return to school as soon as possible, but it will take time to go through the rental procedures and pack his luggage. If the landlord is difficult, it may take some extra time.In addition, she is about to graduate, and the school does not force students to live in the dormitory. It would not be strange for her to wait until the start of school and then go back.

The sun hung high in the sky, but it was almost completely blocked by the tall buildings. Even though it was not yet night, the streets were already flashing with dazzling neon lights.

Vehicles with strange shapes and unique decorations fly through the air.

In Hongfu City, ordinary people can only drive in fixed areas, but as long as they pay enough money, they can apply for a dedicated lane. Some legal experts once believed that this would infringe on the spatial privacy rights of high-rise residents.This was debated at Liberty University's law school.

After getting on the empty train on the way back, Du Jinghua found an empty seat and sat down, and began to think about the reason for his sudden return to school today.

Dungeons, games... all kinds of events indicate that the world is undergoing earth-shaking changes. My identity as an illegal player may have attracted the attention of some people. The other party may have noticed something, but they don't know who the target is. It may also be that students of ancient ruins themselves have eye-catching qualities, so they sent people to investigate the situation.

Ignoring the thoughts of the people behind him for the time being, Du Jinghua hurried back to his rental house in the West District after leaving campus. He simply tidied up and ate a bowl of convenient and nutritious meals, and then began to prepare for his daily tasks.

She had no intention of not logging into the game's main city forever, but before logging in, sufficient weapon reserves were necessary.

Du Jinghua's backpack contained the wood she had brought from "Village Celebration" before. She put the communicator with dangerous software downloaded in the living room to charge, and squatted in the bedroom to rub the arrows.

When she used nameless gems to upgrade [Public Face], Du Jinghua mastered a forging skill [Item Synthesis], and she wanted to try to see if she could embed wolf fangs on arrows.

After Du Jinghua polished the wolf's fang, he inserted it into the head of the arrow, and then used his skills to fuse the two sides smoothly.

The attack power of arrows inlaid with wolf teeth is 10 points higher than that of ordinary arrows, and there is a chance of causing bleeding.

After all the wolf fangs brought out were consumed, Du Jinghua's item synthesis skill was upgraded to the intermediate level. She knew in her heart that the experience gained from making arrows today was actually quite limited. She was able to upgrade so quickly mainly because she had used nameless gems before. Using high-end materials to create items can bring more experience.

Du Jinghua sorted out the old quiver and put the arrows into categories - she liked the old quiver very much. In comparison, although the backpack can also store arrows, different types of arrows must be placed in different backpack compartments, and the maximum stacking number is only 99. The quiver can hold different types of arrows at the same time.

It's a pity that there are not many minerals on hand. In Du Jinghua's impression, arrows made of metal will have a certain probability of penetrating the target. The specific probability is inversely proportional to the defense value.

The memories that come to mind are like sculptures that have been accidentally broken. Some places are coherent, while others are like powder scattered everywhere, fragmented and disordered.

Once you obtain ownership of "Village Celebration", you can regularly obtain dungeon harvests.All harvests will accumulate over time. Currently, I have obtained two units of rabbit meat and one unit of forest sage. I don’t know if there will be other types of materials in the future.

Forest sage can be found on the outskirts of villages. It is more effective than ordinary sage and can make high-quality healing potions.
